purpose: Verify the fixed $pmux rule: structure, exhaustive simulation, cell-level equivalence, and a real design through the same map
interpretation: 8/24/1 mux2_1 instances, 393608 simulated vectors with 0 mismatches, and Yosys proves the mapped netlist equal to pmuxtree's reference for both single-select probes.
limitations: Equivalence is against a behavioural mux2_1 model whose function matches sky130_full_subset.lib (A0&!S)|(A1&S); it is not a library-timing aware proof.

S_WIDTH=3 is checked by exhaustive one-hot simulation, not by equivalence: pmuxtree and the mapper chain pick different priorities when several select bits are high, which the one-hot $pmux contract leaves open.
Formal equivalence covers combinational behaviour only; no delay, load or glitch analysis.
